note: Bundled sample feed. Used whenever environment.news is left unconfigured, so the News page works without a third-party API key.

articles.title: Central banks hold rates steady as inflation cools
articles.summary: Policymakers left benchmark rates unchanged for a third consecutive meeting, pointing to slowing price growth and a labour market that is loosening without a sharp rise in unemployment.

articles.title: Instant payments cross a billion transactions a month
articles.summary: Account-to-account transfers settled in seconds have overtaken card payments for peer-to-peer transfers, with retail adoption climbing fastest among users under thirty-five.

articles.title: Retail deposits shift toward higher-yield savings
articles.summary: Households continue to move balances out of current accounts and into term deposits, tightening funding costs for banks that were slow to raise their own savings rates.

articles.title: Card networks tighten rules on subscription billing
articles.summary: New requirements oblige merchants to send a reminder before each renewal and to offer cancellation through the same channel used to subscribe.

articles.title: Mortgage applications rebound on cheaper fixed terms
articles.summary: Lenders reported the strongest week of applications this year after several cut their five-year fixed offers, though approval rates remain below pre-tightening levels.

articles.title: Open banking data sharing becomes the default
articles.summary: Account aggregation now covers savings, loans and pensions in addition to current accounts, giving budgeting tools a fuller picture of household finances.

articles.title: Fraud losses fall as confirmation-of-payee expands
articles.summary: Checking the payee name against the account before a transfer completes has cut misdirected-payment fraud sharply, with the biggest gains in first-time transfers.

articles.title: Small businesses lean on embedded lending
articles.summary: Credit offered inside accounting and payments software is growing faster than traditional overdrafts, particularly for firms with seasonal cash-flow gaps.
